name: Post-starburst galaxy GAL-021143-440740 (Hubble)
blurb: GAL-021143-440740, an interacting post-starburst (E+A) galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: gal021143440740-hubble
story: A galaxy whose burst of star formation has recently ended. Hubble studied galaxies like this as a possible missing link between merging spirals and ordinary ellipticals, to see whether the interactions that create them destroy their disks.

claims.text: GAL-021143-440740 is an interacting starburst galaxy targeted by Hubble program 9781
The program images E+A (post-starburst) galaxies from the Las Campanas Redshift Survey
E+A galaxies may connect merging spirals with normal ellipticals and S0s
The program aims to find what fraction of the interactions that lead to E+As destroy all disk-like structures
